title: cyclophorus subvelutinus
intro: Cyclophorus subvelutinus, commonly known as the velvet cyclophorus, is a plant species belonging to the Apocynaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cyclophorus subvelutinus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. However, further research is needed to fully understand its effects and potential uses, and it is not yet widely recognized as a medicinal plant.
